CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2770 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 8a29702db07ec8fd3e760f7e73fe7cd7b9cd5b80. Bus nonce: 01be551ceca7cdd1cf4b7eea62269bee. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 8a29702db07ec8fd3e760f7e73fe7cd7b9cd5b80`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 8a29702db07ec8fd3e760f7e73fe7cd7b9cd5b80` or `Fix review: blocked 8a29702db07ec8fd3e760f7e73fe7cd7b9cd5b80 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 01be551ceca7cdd1cf4b7eea62269bee`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `8a29702db07ec8fd3e760f7e73fe7cd7b9cd5b80` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2770 8a29702db07ec8fd3e760f7e73fe7cd7b9cd5b80") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2770-01be551c`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Verdict re-post only for #2770 at its live head (check it is 8a29702db07ec8fd3e760f7e73fe7cd7b9cd5b80). Your earlier merge verdict stands: re-verify nothing beyond reading that the head is unchanged and the code is the one reviewed (merge verdict at 8a29702d, review/2770). Re-issue the same merge verdict with the same evidence, with one change: three `## Evidence` bullets are read by tools/audit/carry_audit.py as deferrals though they are not findings, so end each with a dismissal line `Carry: dismissed: <reason of two or more words>`:
- the bullet beginning "My mutants (ev/mutants.txt, driver ev/mutants_driver.py) were applied one at a time to the head and restored" (item 966bc31f, comment 6390514582),
- the bullet beginning "Finder-shape harness `dev/audit/harnesses/r10_gate_defer_race.py`. It is fixer-built" (item 80cd9485, comment 6391986616),
- the bullet beginning "Mutants. The driver and output are ev/mutants_driver.py and ev/mutants.txt" (item e516ff36, comment 6391986616).
Reasons are of the form "evidence record, not a finding". Check with `python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py --repo tvofi/heatpump_optimizer --roster-ref origin/main pr 2770` that the three read dismissed/routed (0 unrouted from your verdict) before you push. Line 1 stays the merge grammar at the live head.
No host or home paths in anything you push; cite repo-relative paths only.
